description: Flux r9 evidence is a scoped single-file refinement harness mapped to named pure production proof surfaces; it does not mechanically import or verify full vb_storage implementation bodies.
justification: Enabling package metadata caused a Flux internal compiler error in unrelated admission iterator/projection code before recovery properties could be checked. Keeping production code unannotated avoids invasive crate-mode migration in this sublane.

description: Harness functions correspond by inspection to named pure helpers in crates/vb_storage/src/recovery/types.rs, hydrate.rs, replay/core.rs, and replay/summary.rs; Flux does not link these functions to production symbols.
justification: The mapped production helpers are pure boolean/arithmetic surfaces, but the full crate includes external crates, iterators, collections, JournalEvent variants, Vec outputs, and I/O-oriented code outside this scoped Flux proof.

description: ActionReplayTracker HashSet insertion/contains for one action-step pair is abstracted to completed/failed boolean membership facts; r9 proves resolution exactness and monotonicity over that public surface only.
justification: Flux r9 verifies the non-vacuous refined return types of mark_completed, mark_failed, and is_resolved, not std::collections::HashSet implementation semantics.

description: A temporary [package.metadata.flux] enabled=true probe made cargo flux verify the full crate and failed with a Flux internal compiler error in crates/vb_storage/src/admission.rs:270, unrelated to the r9 recovery harness.
justification: Production and Cargo metadata were restored unchanged. Single-file mode remains the accepted scoped Flux artifact for this r9 sublane until crate-mode adoption is planned separately.

description: Trusted-boundary scan over verification/flux and mapped production recovery files found only #![forbid(unsafe_code)] lines; no Flux trusted, trusted_impl, extern_spec, ignore, no_panic, or no_panic_if markers were present.
justification: The r9 harness uses checked bodies and #[should_fail] negatives; it adds no trusted or ignored Flux surface.
